CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid plugins by tabilzad, MIT licensed and maintained on GitHub. This repository is the Community Applications feed: it holds the listing metadata only, and each plugin's code, releases and issues live in its own repository. Plugins: Docker Batch Update, which adds a Batch Update tab to the Docker page for updating the containers you pick in one go, and Claude Code for Unraid, which installs Anthropic's Claude Code command-line agent natively on the host with a persistent login, restorable sessions and an enforced safety policy (a community project, not affiliated with Anthropic or Lime Technology). Support: the forum thread or the GitHub issues linked from each plugin.
